commentary: Both kings are sheltered so central play deserves closer attention. The supported king pawns currently limit the central files. A change in that structure would affect the scope of several pieces. White still needs to develop the queenside knight and bishop. Those pieces need useful squares before the position becomes sharper. The developed bishops already point toward the opposing kingside pawns. Direct captures still require checking the opponent's most forcing replies. White should balance development, central play, and tactical safety.
